motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of items passed together without separate discussion; the motion does not list what was included.
motions.impact: Nothing here changes for residents on its own — the individual items are listed on the meeting agenda.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Steeplechase South Subdivision Second Plat Amendment (877 N Pony Express Parkway)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Steeplechase South Subdivision Second Plat Amendment (877 N Pony Express Parkway). Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Steeplechase South subdivision plat amended
motions.summary: The city approved a second plat amendment for the Steeplechase South subdivision at 877 N Pony Express Parkway.
motions.impact: This adjusts the recorded layout of one subdivision on Pony Express Parkway. Unless you live in or are buying in Steeplechase South, nothing changes for you.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.140 for Right of Way Profile Illustrations
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.140 for Right of Way Profile Illustrations. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Update street cross-section diagrams in city code
motions.summary: The city updated the right-of-way profile illustrations in its code — the standard diagrams showing how streets are to be laid out.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day. These are the technical drawings engineers and developers follow when designing new streets.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.090 Privacy Screening, Section 17.40.020 Land Use Table, and Section 17.60.120 General Fencing Provisions
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.090 Privacy Screening, Section 17.40.020 Land Use Table, and Section 17.60.120 General Fencing Provisions. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New rules for fences and privacy screening
motions.summary: The city amended its code covering fences, privacy screening, and the table of land uses allowed in each zone; the motion does not state what specifically changed.
motions.impact: If you are planning a fence or a screening wall on your property, the rules you have to build to have changed — check the current code before you start.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Purchasing Policy Section 3.20.030 (H) to Modify the Approval Process for Change Orders
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Purchasing Policy Section 3.20.030 (H) to Modify the Approval Process for Change Orders. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change the sign-off process for change orders
motions.summary: The city rewrote its purchasing rules to change how change orders — the cost adjustments made after a contract is already underway — get approved.
motions.impact: This is internal paperwork and nothing changes for residents. It affects how city staff and the council sign off on added costs for work already under contract.

motions.item_title: Add traffic calming measures and traffic related actions to the Legislative Priorities List
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to add traffic calming measures and traffic related actions to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Traffic calming added to priority list
motions.summary: The council added traffic calming and other traffic-related actions to the city's list of legislative priorities.
motions.impact: No speed bumps or new signs come from this on its own. It flags traffic as something the city wants to work on; any real change comes later.

motions.item_title: Add discussions with public safety partners and the Public Safety Director to include a Youth C…
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to add discussions with public safety partners and the Public Safety Director to include a Youth Court, Justice Court and other public safety measures to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Youth court and justice court added to priority list
motions.summary: The council added a youth court, a justice court, and other public safety measures to the city's list of legislative priorities.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet. This only puts these ideas on the city's priority list — an actual youth or justice court would take separate decisions later.
